latvia.title: 'All quiet on the Eastern front' photo show opens in Narva
latvia.description: An international photo exhibition at the University of Tartu Narva College explores Europe and NATO's eastern border through history, culture and psychology.

latvia.title: Peeter Kaldre: NATO's secret war
latvia.description: It cannot be said that NATO is sitting helplessly with its hands in its lap, fearfully waiting for a Russian attack. Preparations are underway — only the media pays little attention to them, because headlines suggesting an imminent catastrophe sell better, writes Peeter Kaldre.

latvia.title: Augustis ei registreeritud Eestis ühtegi kõnekelmust, kahjud olid viimase kahe aasta madalaimad
latvia.description: Möödunud kuul Ukrainas toimunud ulatuslikud politseioperatsioonid petturite kõnekeskuste vastu on mõjutanud ka Eestis toime pandud kelmusi, kuid politsei sõnul otsivad petturid juba uusi viise inimesteni jõudmiseks.

latvia.title: NATO liitlased nurjasid Venemaa plaani saboteerida merekaableid
latvia.description: NATO liitlased tabasid kevadel Arktika vetes Teravmägede (Svalbardi) saarestiku lähedal Vene allveelaevad, mis harjutasid salajase relva kasutamist, mis oli mõeldud kriitilise tähtsusega merekaablite rivist välja viimiseks jälgi jätmata, kirjutab Reuters.

latvia.title: WATCH LIVE: Rīga Conference, Day 1
latvia.description: Watch day one of the Rīga Conference live here on LSM.

latvia.title: Unlawful employment of foreign athletes found this summer in Latvia
latvia.description: Officials from the State Border Guard discovered over the summer that six foreign sportsmen had been employed as professional footballers without having been granted the necessary work permits, the Border Guard told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Latvia, Estonia, Ukraine joining forces to clean up the world
latvia.description: The World Cleanup Day events, taking place around the world on September 20th for the ninth time, will be covered via an international live broadcast from Rīga, Latvia, it has been announced.

latvia.title: Latvia gets winning start at European volleyball championship
latvia.description: The Latvian men's volleyball team had a successful start to its European Championship (Eurovol) final tournament on September 9th with a 3-1 (26:24; 18:25; 25:21, 26:24) victory over hosts Romania.

latvia.title: Latvia's Oscar nominee 'Ulya' coming to cinemas
latvia.description: Starting 16 September, director Viesturs Kairišs’ new feature film “Uļa/Ulya” will be screened in cinemas across Latvia. The film had its international premiere this year in the “Un Certain Regard” section of the Cannes Film Festival and has been nominated by Latvia for the Academy Award, the film’s team announced.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Romania men's international volleyball
latvia.description: Latvia plays Romania in an international volleyball match on September 9th. Watch live, courtesy of Latvian Television's coverage.

latvia.title: WATCH LIVE: Nordic Resilience Summit 2026
latvia.description: The second Nordic Resilience Summit takes place on 10th September at the National Library of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Unhelpful advice on choosing a party
latvia.description: As Latvians ponder whether to bother voting in Saeima elections on October 3rd, there is no shortage of people urging them on from the sidelines.

latvia.title: Record season for cruise ships in Liepāja, Latvia
latvia.description: In early September, the last cruise ship of the season, carrying 600 passengers, docked in Liepāja. This was the seventh such visit this year, which is a record for recent years, TV Kurzeme reported.

latvia.title: Fuel prices approaching record highs in Latvia
latvia.description: Fuel prices in Latvia are approaching record highs, whilst oil prices on the global market are once again rising sharply, Latvian Television reported on September 9.

latvia.title: Thursday will be windy and much cooler in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that on Thursday the weather in Latvia will become cooler, windier and, at times, rainy.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 9th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Baltic states still a suicide blackspot
latvia.description: The Baltic states are among the places in Europe with the highest number of suicides per head of population, according to Eurostat figures published on September 9th.

latvia.title: Heat records broken Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: By 3 pm on Wednesday, the 9 September heat record had been broken at three observation stations, according to data from the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Kulbergs: Latvia needs 7 billion euros from EU for eastern border
latvia.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs said on September 9th that Latvia requires 7 billion euros over the next seven years in order to strengthen its eastern border – which is also part of the European Union's external border.

latvia.title: CSDD customers come forward with compensation claims
latvia.description: The Road Traffic Safety Directorate (CSDD) has received around 2,500 claims for compensation relating to the cyber incident involving a data breach, Mārtiņš Mālmeisters, Head of the CSDD’s Communications Department, told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Previously unknown ancient fish fossil discovered in Latvia
latvia.description: Researchers from the University of Latvia (LU), in collaboration with Swedish and Australian palaeontologists, have discovered a previously unknown species of lungfish in Upper Devonian deposits in Kurzeme, the University of Latvia has announced.

latvia.title: Latvia saw double-digit trade growth in July
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) provisional data show that in July 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of EUR 4.01 billion, and at current prices it was 10.5 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Dutch Foreign Minister gets a bird's eye view of Latvia's eastern border
latvia.description: On 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, hosted Tom Berendsen, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands, who was visiting Latvia for the first time.

latvia.title: Is stolen grain from Ukraine beng shipped via Latvia?
latvia.description: If the checks reveal that the relevant grains do come from Ukraine, a month will have passed and the specific cargo will have already moved on in transit. However, the PVD will have information about the carrier and the origin of the grains. "This will be a reason for making other decisions in the future at the European Union level," said Balodis.

latvia.title: Latvian government undecided on airBaltic funding
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Cabinet of Ministers (CM) backed the continuation of the financial stabilisation process for Latvia’s national airline, airBaltic, but did not yet decide on the state’s possible involvement in providing temporary funding, the Ministry of Transport (SM) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Missing Latvians believed to have been in China, not Nepal
latvia.description: China has officially confirmed that all 33 missing Latvian nationals were believed to be in Tibet at the time of the recent catastrophic floods and had not crossed the border back to Nepal, Edīte Medne, Director of the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, confirmed on Wednesday.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Riga Conference Business Forum
latvia.description: Live coverage of the Business Forum on September 9th, ahead of the Riga Conference on September 10th-11th.

latvia.title: Latvia's primary school pupil-teacher ratio close to EU average
latvia.description: According to latest Eurostat data, Latvia's pupil-to-teacher ratio in primary schools is close the European Union avergage, even though it has risen over the last decade.

latvia.title: Fuel prices not expected to fall anytime soon in Latvia
latvia.description: At the start of September, fuel prices in Latvia have once again risen above two euros per litre. Current trends suggest that fuel prices are not expected to fall or stabilise, as Ieva Ligere, head of the Latvian Fuel Retailers’ Association, said in an interview on the Latvian television programme “Morning Panorama” on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: Suspected people-smuggler from Poland caught in Latvia
latvia.description: On Monday, September 7th, border guards in Jēkabpils region, in cooperation with State Police officials, detained a person transporting people who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Latvia will send de-mining force to Straits of Hormuz
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 8, the Cabinet of Ministers supported a draft decision on the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in international operations in the Straits of Hormuz.

latvia.title: State Audit: Latvia has work to do in foreign labour policies
latvia.description: The State Audit Office has concluded in its audit, published on September 9, that Latvia lacks a clear approach to attracting foreign labour that is based on the needs of the labour market.

latvia.title: 'Tet' to open big data centre in Latvia
latvia.description: The telecommunications company “Tet” is set to open a new data centre in Salaspils on Wednesday, 9 September, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Warm, even hot Wednesday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that Wednesday in Latvia will be warm, even hot, with summer-like weather.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 8th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia will give 100,000 euros to help Nepal
latvia.description: On 8th September, the Cabinet of Ministers approved a plan by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to provide EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the floods.

latvia.title: Latvia's education system is not top of the class
latvia.description: Latvian students' performance in science, mathematics and reading have deteriorated to a new low, but digital skills are better than the average of the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) countries, according to the latest edition of the important 'PISA' educational rankings.

latvia.title: Blood donors needed in Latvia
latvia.description: The National Blood Donor Centre (VADC) is calling on the public to come forward and donate blood, the centre said in a release on September 8.

latvia.title: Latvia's heating fuel supply stable, prices less so
latvia.description: Heat supply companies are preparing for the heating season and currently regard the average tariff increase as moderate. At the same time, there remains a risk that high woodchip and natural gas costs will lead to an increase in heating prices, Latvian Radio reported on September 8.

latvia.title: Latvian inflation ticked up in August
latvia.description: Latest data published by the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) on September 8th show that in August 2026, compared to July 2026, the average level of consumer prices rose by 0.3 %.

latvia.title: Latvia reportedly ready for men's volleyball European Championship
latvia.description: The Latvian men's volleyball team left for Romania on Monday, where they will play group stage matches in the European Championship final tournament.

latvia.title: Ludza promenade landscaping project gets public thumbs-up
latvia.description: A public vote to decide the most significant building project of last year has ended with the Great Lake Promenade (Ezerkrasta promenāde) in Ludza, proving to be the most popular choice.

latvia.title: Riga IFF announces music video line-up
latvia.description: The Riga International Film Festival (RIGA IFF, 15–25 October) has announces the line-up for its Baltic Music Video Competition.

latvia.title: Demand for Latvian-grown watermelons increases
latvia.description: This season has been a little slower for watermelon growers in Latvia, but the harvest is generally encouraging. On some farms, the watermelons are being bought up straight from the field, without even reaching the market. Growers conclude that the number of watermelon lovers in Latvia is increasing, Latvian Television reported on September 8.

latvia.title: Latvia's labour productivity improved in second quarter
latvia.description: In the second quarter of 2026, labour productivity in the EU increased by 0.9% based on persons and by 0.8% based on hours worked, compared with the same quarter of the previous year. In the first quarter of 2026, labour productivity had increased by 0.4% based on both persons and hours worked compared with the same quarter of the previous year.

latvia.title: Numerous Foreign Ministers descending upon Rīga this week
latvia.description: What is the collective noun for Foreign Ministers? A gaggle? A conclave? A diplomacy? Whatever, on 9th September 2026, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, will be in full-on hostess mode as she welcomes no fewer than seven fellow Foreign Ministers to Rīga.

latvia.title: Latvia and Armenia sign immigration protocol
latvia.description: On 7th September, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže and Minister of Foreign Affairs of Armenia, Ararat Mirzoyan, signed a protocol on the implementation of the EU-Armenia readmission agreement.

latvia.title: Residents of explosion-damaged house in Rīga still at a loss about future
latvia.description: On 2 January this year, residents of Bauskas Street 15, Rīga, were left homeless following a gas explosion. The Latvian Television programme “Aizliegtais paņēmiens/Forbidden Method” found out what is currently happening with the building affected by the explosion and how its residents are faring.

latvia.title: Latvia plans to ban bus routes to Russia, Belarus next year
latvia.description: From 2027, it is planned to ban regular and occasional international passenger transport by coach to Russia and Belarus, as well as transit through Latvian territory to these countries. This is provided for in proposals for amendments to the Road Transport Law, prepared by the Ministry of Transport and submitted to the government for consideration.

latvia.title: Latvian public media campaign for Ukrainian soldiers continues
latvia.description: To mark Ukraine’s Independence Day, Latvian Public Media, in collaboration with the charity organisation “Ziedot.lv”, is organising a fundraising campaign entitled “In thoughts and deeds together with Ukraine”.

latvia.description: The Latvian Passenger Carriers Association (LPPA), in cooperation with passenger carriers, will organize a protest action on September 16th, during which regional passenger carriers will stop providing public transport bus services commissioned by the state for one day, reports LSM's Latvian-language service.

latvia.title: Appeal for materials about Latvia's Jewish chess pastmasters
latvia.description: The Riga Jewish Community and the Museum “Jews in Latvia” are currently preparing an exhibition dedicated to the anniversaries of famous chess players Aron Nimzowitsch (1886-1935), Aleksandr Koblenz (1916-1993), and Mikhail Tal (1936-1992), as well as to the overall contribution of Jews to the history of Latvian chess.

latvia.description: The Commander of the Latvian National Guard, Aivars Krjukovs, stated in the LSM series "Formā!" latvia.description: Rīgas dome ceturtdien ārkārtas sēdē apstiprināja deputāta Mārtiņa Enģeļa (P) deputāta pilnvaru izbeigšanu pirms termiņa. lithuania.title: Behind Trump’s push to break the International Criminal Court
lithuania.description: The U.S. is on a public campaign to dismantle the International Criminal Court. Now, it wants help from its NATO allies.  During a closed-door meeting back in July, U.S. envoy to NATO Matthew Whitaker asked allied countries for help in disassembling the international court that addresses genocide and crimes against humanity.  On the show, Sarah Wheaton and Kathryn […]

lithuania.title: Almost 80% of Poles support helping Baltic states if Russia attacks
lithuania.description: The poll follows controversy over comments by a senior opposition figure casting doubt over Poland fulfilling its NATO obligations.

lithuania.title: Tajná operácia pod hladinou: NATO zastavilo ruské ponorky pri pokuse o útok
lithuania.description: Armády krajín Severoatlantickej aliancie prekazili sabotáž ruských ponoriek, ktoré neďaleko súostrovia Špicbergy nacvičovali poškodzovanie podmorských káblov. Operáciu, počas ktorej Rusko testovalo využitie sofistikovanej vojenskej techniky nezanechávajúcej stopy, odhalili na jar armády Spojených štátov, Británie a Nórska, napísala vo štvrtok agentúra Reuters s odvolaním sa na dva nemenované zdroje.

lithuania.title: ÎNTREBAREA SĂPTĂMÂNII: Ce înseamnă „naționalism sănătos" în viziunea lui Nicușor Dan și ce calcul politic poate sta în spatele formulei
lithuania.description: „Într-o țară fără guvern de patru luni, președintele ne propune teme de reflecție. Iar sintagma «naționalism sănătos» pare mai degrabă o nadă politică pentru electoratul suveranist", spune Florin Negruțiu. Claudiu Pândaru adaugă: „România excelează la sintagme, nu la valori puse în practică. Iar întrebarea reală este dacă Nicușor Dan are, pentru electoratul pe care îl caută acum, «față de popă».

lithuania.title: Cum a dejucat NATO un complot rusesc de sabotare a cablurilor submarine. Operațiune complicată a Direcției GUGI
lithuania.description: În adâncurile apelor arctice, în apropierea îndepărtatului arhipelag Svalbard, aliaţii NATO au surprins în această primăvară submarine ruseşti antrenându-se pentru a lansa o armă secretă concepută să dezactiveze cabluri submarine critice fără a lăsa urme. Operaţiunea clandestină rusă, descrisă agenţiei Reuters de doi oficiali occidentali, era desfăşurată de Direcţia GUGI de război subacvatic a Moscovei, care a utilizat submersibile de adâncime pentru a simula desfăşurarea acestei tehnologii sofisticate şi distructive.

lithuania.title: Șeful serviciilor speciale din Polonia a dat detalii SUA despre sabotajele Rusiei în țări europene
lithuania.description: Coordonatorul serviciilor speciale poloneze, Tomasz Siemoniak, a declarat că a prezentat Statelor Unite informații privind sabotajele susținute de Rusia în Polonia și în alte părți ale Europei. Ministrul polonez responsabil cu serviciile speciale ale țării s-a întâlnit cu un înalt oficial al serviciilor de informații naționale ale SUA pentru a discuta despre amenințările la adresa Poloniei, pe fondul temerilor legate de sabotajele sponsorizate de Moscova în întreaga Europă, relatează TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Polonia ia un împrumut de miliarde de dolari, pentru a cumpăra echipament militar american
lithuania.description: Statele Unite ale Americii îi acordă Poloniei un împrumut de miliarde de dolari astfel încât această țară să cumpere echipament militar american. Varșovia a semnat un acord de garantare a împrumuturilor în valoare de 4 miliarde de dolari SUA pentru a contribui la finanțarea achizițiilor de echipament militar american, în contextul în care Polonia continuă să-și consolideze forțele armate și flancul estic al NATO, scrie TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Senatoarea PNL Nicoleta Pauliuc va propune în Comisia pentru apărare maximum două mandate de 5 ani pentru șefii serviciilor
lithuania.description: Senatoarea PNL Nicoleta Pauliuc a anunțat, miercuri, că va depune nouă amendamente la proiectul de lege privind limitarea mandatelor șefilor serviciilor și structurilor de securitate inițiat de USR. Printre propuneri se numără maximum două mandate pentru aceeași persoană, cu o durată de cinci ani, evaluarea anuală în Parlament și reguli mai clare pentru numire și revocare.

lithuania.title: România și SUA vor să extindă cooperarea militară pe Flancul Estic al NATO. Noi planuri discutate la București
lithuania.description: România și Statele Unite vor să ducă mai departe cooperarea militară, într-un context de securitate tot mai complicat pe Flancul Estic al NATO. Noi forme de pregătire și proiecte comune au fost discutate la București de șeful Statului Major al Apărării, generalul Gheorghiță Vlad, cu oficiali de rang înalt ai Gărzii Naționale a SUA.

lithuania.title: Heritage Foundation: România este o ancoră a NATO la Marea Neagră. Recomandările fundației pentru administraţia Trump și Armata Română
lithuania.description: România este una dintre cele mai constante aliate ale Statelor Unite pe flancul estic al NATO, însă potenţialul economic al parteneriatului strategic rămâne în mare parte nevalorificat, investiţiile americane greenfield încetinind din cauza schimbărilor legislative repetate şi a instabilităţii coaliţiei de guvernare de la Bucureşti, se arată într-un raport publicat, marţi, de The Heritage Foundation, unul dintre cele mai influente think tank-uri conservatoare din Washington.

lithuania.title: Mai puțin de 2 din 10 liceeni fac suficientă mișcare. INSP a demarat o campanie națională pentru un stil de viață sănătos. Ce recomandă
lithuania.description: Institutul Naţional de Sănătate Publică (INSP) derulează, în lunile septembrie şi octombrie, o campanie de promovare a alimentaţiei sănătoase şi a activităţii fizice, pornind de la statistici îngrijorătoare. Cel puţin un copil de 7-9 ani din zece este obez şi mai puţin de 2 din 10 elevi de liceu ating nivelul de activitate fizică recomandat de OMS. În cazul adulţilor, sedentarismul şi alimentaţia nepotrivită pot duce la grave probleme de sănătate.

lithuania.title: Petrişor Peiu, despre rezultatele PISA: Mai rău ca noi stau doar Republica Moldova şi Bulgaria. Consecinţele sunt dramatice
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, afirmă, miercuri, după publicarea rezultatelor la testele PISA, că mai rău decât elevii din România stau doar cei din Republica Moldova şi Bulgaria, consecinţele fiind „dramatice”. „Şcoala nu poate asigura o performanţă comparabilă cu media europeană sau occidentală (OCDE) a copiilor care o urmează”, transmite senatorul, odată cu un mesaj către alegători: „Nu vă mai miraţi de calitatea sub-mediocră a liderilor politici”.

lithuania.title: Sardinia, noua „insulă a diavolului”: măsura autorităților italiene privind liderii mafioți care îi nemulțumește pe localnici
lithuania.description: Sardinia este transformată într-o „Insulă a Diavolului” prin decizia autorităților italiene de a transfera în închisoarea sa cei mai notorii șefi mafioți și teroriști, a afirmat guvernatorul acesteia, potrivit The Times.

lithuania.title: Kelemen Hunor: Senatorul Lorant Antal nu a avut mandat de la UDMR să fie în avionul Bucureşti-Mykonos. Nu avea ce căuta acolo
lithuania.description: Senatorul UDMR István-Loránt Antal nu a avut mandat de la partid să se afle în avionul pe ruta Bucureşti - Mykonos şi nu trebuia să se afle în acel avion, a declarat, marţi, preşedintele Uniunii, Kelemen Hunor, potrivit Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu spune că AUR s-a înţeles cu PSD pe subiectul şefilor de la SRR şi SRTv: „Nu am ales-o eu, ştiţi că nu mă pricep la asta”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a recunoscut că a existat o înţelegere cu parlamentarii social-democraţi pe tema şefilor de la Societăţile Române de Radio şi Televiziune, votaţi marţi de Birourile permanente reunite ale celor două Camere.

lithuania.title: Petrişor Peiu: Guvernele Ciolacu şi Bolojan au adus recesiune, inflaţie şi cea mai gravă criză economică de după aderarea ţării la UE
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, acuză guvernele Ciolacu şi Bolojan că au transformat România în „bolnavul economic al Europei” şi au împins ţara în cea mai gravă criză economică de după aderarea la Uniunea Europeană. Parlamentarul avertizează că România este prinsă în stagflaţie, cu doar trei trimestre de creştere economică din ultimele zece şi cu cea mai mare inflaţie din Europa, şi susţine că ţara nu poate fi scoasă din criză de aceiaşi oameni care au provocat-o.

lithuania.title: Lavrov susține că SUA tolerează controlul rusesc în Ucraina și renunță la ideea primirii Ucrainei în NATO
lithuania.description: Lavrov susține că SUA tolerează controlul rusesc în Ucraina și renunță la ideea primirii Ucrainei în NATO

lithuania.title: După Bulgaria, și Ungaria se pregătește să adopte euro. „Ne dorim introducerea cu succes a monedei euro”, spune guvernatorul maghiar
lithuania.description: „Ne dorim o introducere a monedei euro cu succes, nu neapărat una rapidă, dar, bineînțeles, dacă este rapidă, nimeni nu va obiecta”, a spus joi Mihály Varga, șeful Băncii Centrale a Ungariei, la cea de-a 64-a Întâlniri Itinerante a Economiștilor. Potrivit lui Mihály Varga, condițiile pentru o introducere reușită sunt sprijinul social, o economie reală …

lithuania.title: Islanda pregătește interzicerea vânătorii de balene / Doar Norvegia și Japonia ar mai continua vânătoarea comercială
lithuania.description: Guvernul Islandei va prezenta în februarie un proiect de lege pentru interzicerea vânătorii de balene, o măsură care ar face ca Norvegia și Japonia să rămână singurele două țări din lume care continuă vânătoarea comercială de balene, transmite MEDIAFAX. Vânătoarea de balene din Islanda a stârnit ani la rând proteste din partea organizațiilor pentru protecția […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: 'All quiet on the Eastern front' photo show opens in Narva
lithuania.description: An international photo exhibition at the University of Tartu Narva College explores Europe and NATO's eastern border through history, culture and psychology.

lithuania.title: Peeter Kaldre: NATO's secret war
lithuania.description: It cannot be said that NATO is sitting helplessly with its hands in its lap, fearfully waiting for a Russian attack. Preparations are underway — only the media pays little attention to them, because headlines suggesting an imminent catastrophe sell better, writes Peeter Kaldre.

lithuania.title: Augustis ei registreeritud Eestis ühtegi kõnekelmust, kahjud olid viimase kahe aasta madalaimad
lithuania.description: Möödunud kuul Ukrainas toimunud ulatuslikud politseioperatsioonid petturite kõnekeskuste vastu on mõjutanud ka Eestis toime pandud kelmusi, kuid politsei sõnul otsivad petturid juba uusi viise inimesteni jõudmiseks.

lithuania.title: NATO liitlased nurjasid Venemaa plaani saboteerida merekaableid
lithuania.description: NATO liitlased tabasid kevadel Arktika vetes Teravmägede (Svalbardi) saarestiku lähedal Vene allveelaevad, mis harjutasid salajase relva kasutamist, mis oli mõeldud kriitilise tähtsusega merekaablite rivist välja viimiseks jälgi jätmata, kirjutab Reuters.

lithuania.title: Vai Latvija ir gatava karam? Rajevs norāda uz satraucošu problēmu

lithuania.title: Izskan jaunas detaļas par Norvēģijā apdraudēto Zelenska lidmašīnu – šī versija gan krasi atšķiras
lithuania.description: Norvēģijas premjerministrs Jūnass Gārs Stēre trešdienas paziņoja, ka Ukrainas prezidenta Volodimira Zelenska lidmašīnai ceļā no Moldovas uz Norvēģijas karaļa Haralda bērēm Oslo gandrīz trāpījis lidrobots. Kāds avots Ukrainas prezidenta kancelejā gan noradījis, ka tas ir pārspīlējums. “Moldovā bija trauksme, kad krievu [drons] ielidoja Moldovas un Rumānijas gaisa telpā,” pastāstīja avots. Savukārt Moldovas valdības pārstāvis informēja, […]

lithuania.title: Zelenska ceļā uz Norvēģiju noticis satraucošs incidents
lithuania.description: Ukrainas prezidenta Volodimira Zelenska lidmašīnai ceļā no Moldovas uz Norvēģijas karaļa Haralda bērēm Oslo gandrīz trāpījis lidrobots, trešdien paziņojis Norvēģijas premjerministrs Jūnass Gārs Stēre. “Viņa [Zelenska] reisu, kad tas Moldovā pacēlās, gandrīz trāpīja drons. Tā ir realitāte, kurā viņš dzīvo,” sabiedriskajai raidorganizācijai NRK norādīja Stēre. Zelenskis Oslo ieradās otrdienas vakarā.

lithuania.title: Kremlis izgudrojis “ātro ceļu uz mieru”, izvirzot absurdu prasību Amerikas Savienotajām Valstīm
lithuania.description: Kremlis paziņojis, ka ASV varētu veicināt iespējami ātru kara izbeigšanu Ukrainā, taču izvirzījis kādu īpašu prasību, vēsta ārzemju mediji. lithuania.title: Polijas ārlietu ministrs komentē centienus izbeigt karu Ukrainā: “Krievijas pārstāvji atklāti saka, ka…”
lithuania.description: Krievijas diktators Vladimirs Putins joprojām uzskata, ka var uzvarēt karā un sasniegt savus mērķus, tādēļ patlaban nav pamata optimismam par ASV un Krievijas sarunām, trešdien Ādažu militārajā bāzē uzsvēra Polijas ārlietu ministrs Radoslavs Sikorskis kopīgajā preses konferencē ar Latvijas ārlietu ministri Baibu Braži (JV). Viņaprāt, ir labi, ka ASV prezidenta Donalda Trampa īpašais sūtnis Stīvs […]

lithuania.title: Gamykloje Šiauliuose kilo gaisras, sutelktos gausios ugniagesių pajėgos
lithuania.description: Šiauliuose, Liejyklos gatvėje esančioje gamykloje, kilo gaisras. Pirminiais duomenimis, dega dažymo kamera.

lithuania.title: „Kitu atveju suvalgys jus gyvas“: Marco Rubio teisina smūgius laivams su narkotikais
lithuania.description: JAV valstybės sekretorius Marco Rubio trečiadienį lankydamasis Ekvadore gynė prieštaringai vertinamus smūgius įtariamiems narkotikų kontrabandos laivams, teigdamas, kad Lotynų Amerikos karteliai „suvalgys šias šalis gyvas“, jei nebus stabdomi.

lithuania.title: Po eilinės avarijos mašinistai neištvėrė: Lenkijoje rengia išskirtinį protestą
lithuania.description: Lenkiją sukrėtė dar viena geležinkelio avarija – į važiuojantį traukinį rėžėsi sunkvežimis, buvo sužaloti žmonės, viena moteris žuvo. Tad Geležinkelio mašinistų profesinė sąjunga paskelbė, kad jiems „jau gana“, todėl rugsėjo 11-ąją visoje Lenkijoje vyks protestas – ties pervažomis traukiniai mažins greitį iki 20 km/val.

lithuania.title: Šeimos pakete konservatoriai rado uždelsto veikimo bombą: beveik 400 mln. eurų nori perkelti kitai valdžiai?
lithuania.description: Opozicinės Tėvynės sąjungos-Lietuvos krikščionių demokratų atstovai sako palaikantys esminius valdančiųjų parengto vadinamojo paramos šeimai paketo elementus. Vis dėlto jie stebisi, kodėl socialdemokratai nori įvesti nemokamą maitinimą iki pat dešimtos klasės, tam išleisti beveik 380 mln. eurų, o atsakomybę už tai perkelti būsimai valdžiai.

lithuania.title: Paaiškėjo, kokį darbą gavo Julija Svyrydenko
lithuania.description: Kyjivo ekonomikos mokykla (KSE) paskyrė buvusią Ukrainos premjerę Juliją Svyrydenko verslo mokyklos „KSE Business School“ (KSE BS) vadove.

lithuania.title: Kinijos uoste užsiliepsnojus užsienio laivui pranešama, kad yra daug aukų
lithuania.description: Viename rytiniame Kinijos uoste prisišvartavusiame laive su užsienio vėliava kilęs gaisras pareikalavo daug aukų, ketvirtadienį pranešė valstybinė žiniasklaida.

lithuania.title: Kęstutis Budrys: niekas be URM nėra įpareigotas derėtis su Pekinu, bet kalbėti piliečiams neuždrausta
lithuania.description: Mišrios Seimo narių grupės parlamentarams šią savaitę susitikus su Kinijos diplomatais, užsienio reikalų ministras Kęstutis Budrys sako, kad ministerija tokių pokalbių nedraudžia, bet niekas kitas, išskyrus Užsienio reikalų ministeriją, nėra įpareigotas su Pekinu vykdyti derybų.

lithuania.title: Parlamentas ėmėsi įteisinti viešą seksualinių nusikaltėlių prieš vaikus registrą
lithuania.description: Seimas ketvirtadienį pradėjo svarstyti siūlymą įteisinti viešą asmenų, nuteistų už nusikalstamas veikas prieš vaiką, registrą.

lithuania.title: Akibrokštas Rusijoje: vietoje Lietuvos ir Lenkijos memorialo – paminklas rusų kariams
lithuania.description: Sibiro mieste Jakutske Lietuvos ir Lenkijos tremtiniams skirtas memorialas buvo pakeistas paminklu kare Ukrainoje žuvusiems Rusijos kariams, pranešta trečiadienį.

lithuania.title: Remigijus Žemaitaitis nemano, kad Daiva Žebelienė turėtų trauktis iš Seimo valdybos: įtarimų nėra
lithuania.description: Teisėsaugai šią savaitę atlikus kratas pas „Nemuno aušros“ politikus, tarp jų – Seimo vicepirmininkę Daivą Žebelienę, „aušriečių“ lyderis Remigijus Žemaitaitis nemano, kad tai yra priežastis, kodėl jo partietė turėtų trauktis iš parlamento valdybos.

lithuania.title: Ministras: gali vėluoti „nereikšminga“ divizijos infrastruktūra, įranga, bet ypatingos grėsmės nėra
lithuania.description: Krašto apsaugos ministras Robertas Kaunas sako, kad gali vėluoti „nereikšminga“ kariuomenės nacionalinei divizijai reikalinga infrastruktūra, bet ypatingos grėsmės neįgyti viso operacinio pajėgumo iki 2030-ųjų nėra.

lithuania.title: Disidentas Ilja Jašinas turi pasiūlymą, ką rusams daryti rinkimų dieną 12 val.
lithuania.description: Užsienyje gyvenantis Rusijos opozicijos politikas Ilja Jašinas paragino „prieš karą nusiteikusius rusus“ visame pasaulyje per šį mėnesį vyksiančius Rusijos parlamento rinkimus balsuoti prieš prezidento Vladimiro Putino valdančiąją partiją.

lithuania.title: Putinas negali apsaugoti savo „elito“: Ukraina užkūrė pragarą Sočyje
lithuania.description: Antradienio vakarą Sočio miestą Rusijoje užpuolė Ukrainos bepiločiai jūriniai dronai. Skelbiama, kad dėl to prieplaukoje įsiplieskė gaisras. Pasak liudininkų, mieste aidėjo sprogimai, o uosto rajone buvo matomas gaisras.

lithuania.title: Regioninė darbo rinka: iššūkiai, galimos politikos priemonės, regionų vaidmuo
lithuania.description: Sostinės regione reikiamų įgūdžių stinga 7 proc. darbuotojų, Vidurio ir Vakarų Lietuvoje – dvigubai daugiau, rodo Pasaulio banko duomenys. Kodėl kvalifikacijos ir darbo rinkos poreikiai prasilenkia ir ar sprendimus dėl to dar turi priimti centrinė valdžia, svarstė „Regioninės politikos forumo 2026“ diskusijos dalyviai.
